visible_content: {"issues":[{"claim_span_id":"cc-claim-cc6-outcome-unknown-en","status":"insufficient_evidence","nature":"insufficient_evidence","category":"event_status","severity":"medium","explanation":"Draft 声称调查日志证明 Doran 完成了南脊测绘，但所引日志只记录测绘开始，并明确未说明是否完成。","reasoning":"唯一被引证据是背景缺失环节：Doran 在第三天开始测绘南脊，且日志未说明测绘是否完成。它支持“已开始”，但不支持“已完成”。缺失的环节是一条记录测绘完成（或未完成）的日志条目，因此判断在此中止：完成与否均未确立，草稿把“完成”归因于日志是没有来源支撑的。没有作者可用的更正动作能补上这条不存在的记录，故 available_actions 为空。","temporal_basis":{"claim_anchor":null,"evidence_anchor":null,"relation":"unknown"},"evidence":[{"chapter_id":"cc-chapter-cc6-outcome-unknown-en-S1","span_id":"cc-span-cc6-outcome-unknown-en-S1","relation":"context","sufficiency":"insufficient","related_memory_ids":["cc-memory-cc6-outcome-unknown-en-S1"]}],"evidence_chain":[{"span_id":"cc-span-cc6-outcome-unknown-en-S1","role":"missing_link"}],"suggested_revision":null,"available_actions":[]}],"claim_verdicts":[{"claim_span_id":"cc-claim-cc6-outcome-unknown-en","verdict":"insufficient_evidence","basis":"所引日志只记载第三天开始测绘且未说明是否完成，缺少记录完成结果的环节；草稿将“完成”说成日志所确立的事实，属无来源支撑的断言。"}]}
